_comment: BloodHound CE custom Cypher queries for OSCP AD enumeration. Import via the loader script (load-bloodhound-ce-queries.sh) which POSTs each to /api/v2/saved-queries, or paste each 'query' into the CE Cypher tab and click Save. CE schema: owned = system_tags CONTAINS 'owned'; Tier Zero / high value = system_tags CONTAINS 'admin_tier_0'. Mark your foothold principals Owned first so the owned-aware queries work.

queries.name: OSCP · What can my OWNED do right now
queries.description: Every outbound control edge from principals you have marked Owned. Your immediate move list.
queries.query: MATCH p=(n)-[r]->(m) WHERE n.system_tags CONTAINS 'owned' RETURN p LIMIT 500

queries.name: OSCP · Shortest path OWNED -> Domain Admins
queries.description: The plan: how to get from what you hold to Domain Admins.
queries.query: MATCH (s) WHERE s.system_tags CONTAINS 'owned' MATCH (g:Group) WHERE g.name STARTS WITH 'DOMAIN ADMINS@' MATCH p=shortestPath((s)-[*1..]->(g)) RETURN p

queries.name: OSCP · Shortest path OWNED -> any Tier Zero
queries.description: Paths from owned to any high-value / Tier Zero object (DC, DA group, krbtgt, etc).
queries.query: MATCH (s) WHERE s.system_tags CONTAINS 'owned' MATCH (t) WHERE t.system_tags CONTAINS 'admin_tier_0' MATCH p=shortestPath((s)-[*1..]->(t)) RETURN p

queries.name: OSCP · Hosts my OWNED can shell (AdminTo/RDP/PSRemote)
queries.description: Computers reachable for code execution from owned principals (incl. via group membership).
queries.query: MATCH p=(n)-[:AdminTo|CanRDP|CanPSRemote|MemberOf*1..]->(c:Computer) WHERE n.system_tags CONTAINS 'owned' RETURN p

queries.name: OSCP · Kerberoastable users
queries.description: All users with an SPN set (request + hashcat -m 13100).
queries.query: MATCH (u:User) WHERE u.hasspn=true RETURN u.name AS user, u.serviceprincipalnames AS spns ORDER BY u.name

queries.name: OSCP · Kerberoastable WITH path to DA (roast first)
queries.description: Service accounts worth cracking because they chain to Domain Admins.
queries.query: MATCH (u:User) WHERE u.hasspn=true MATCH (g:Group) WHERE g.name STARTS WITH 'DOMAIN ADMINS@' MATCH p=shortestPath((u)-[*1..]->(g)) RETURN p

queries.name: OSCP · AS-REP roastable users
queries.description: Users with pre-auth disabled (GetNPUsers -no-pass, hashcat -m 18200). No creds needed.
queries.query: MATCH (u:User) WHERE u.dontreqpreauth=true RETURN u.name ORDER BY u.name

queries.name: OSCP · Passwords in the description field
queries.description: Classic leak: cleartext creds left in AD object descriptions.
queries.query: MATCH (u:User) WHERE u.description IS NOT NULL AND u.description =~ '(?i).*(pass|pwd|cred|secret|pw:|login).*' RETURN u.name AS user, u.description AS description

queries.name: OSCP · Computers with a Domain Admin session
queries.description: Own these hosts and dump LSASS to capture Domain Admin creds.
queries.query: MATCH p=(c:Computer)-[:HasSession]->(u:User)-[:MemberOf*1..]->(g:Group) WHERE g.name STARTS WITH 'DOMAIN ADMINS@' RETURN p

queries.name: OSCP · Unconstrained delegation computers
queries.description: Coerce a DC to auth here, capture its TGT. High impact.
queries.query: MATCH (c:Computer) WHERE c.unconstraineddelegation=true RETURN c.name ORDER BY c.name

queries.name: OSCP · Who can DCSync the domain
OSCP · Shadow-credential targets from OWNED (AddKeyCredentialLink)
queries.description: Objects your owned principals can add key credentials to (certipy shadow / pywhisker -> PKINIT).
queries.query: MATCH p=(n)-[:AddKeyCredentialLink]->(m) WHERE n.system_tags CONTAINS 'owned' RETURN p

queries.name: OSCP · ACL edges from OWNED (GenericAll/Write/DACL/Owner/ForceChangePw/AddMember)
queries.description: All abusable ACL edges you currently hold.
queries.query: MATCH p=(n)-[:GenericAll|GenericWrite|WriteDacl|WriteOwner|Owns|ForceChangePassword|AddMember]->(m) WHERE n.system_tags CONTAINS 'owned' RETURN p

queries.name: OSCP · All Tier Zero objects
queries.description: Everything the domain treats as crown jewels - your objectives list.
queries.query: MATCH (n) WHERE n.system_tags CONTAINS 'admin_tier_0' RETURN n.name AS name, labels(n) AS type ORDER BY name
